items.guidance: Check which code reads .git/refs/heads/master at build or run time, for example a script that writes a commit hash into a version file. Replace that read with the GIT_SHA build argument passed in the same place, so the image still records a commit value and falls back to unknown when none is given.

Find the port in the @hapi/hapi server options in /emailengine/server.js or the configuration defaults it loads, including any app-specific environment variable or command-line flag for the API port. Use that value in EXPOSE. If the app reads a variable other than PORT, do not add ENV PORT; report that variable name.

Check whether server.js starts the bullmq Worker instances itself, for example in worker threads it spawns, or whether a separate script starts them. Report the file that creates each bullmq Worker and the process that loads it. Also report which configuration value sets the Redis connection, so it can be mapped to REDIS_URL.
